title: EGP Graphai • Lexical Map Index Crosswalk
description: Cell-level entries of one external index (Strong's, for instance) placed onto paradigm cells. A corpus tags at the lexical level; an index may go finer. Each rule names a root and either the parse codes a cell must carry or the single spelling it must have, and every cell that matches takes the rule's number in place of the corpus's.

_id.description: The index this file places, matching its key under `indices` in the codex (`strongs`).

language.description: The language registry this belongs to.

rules.description: Placement rules. Two rules must not both match one cell; the validator checks that.

n.description: An index entry that has no cell here, with the reason.

unplaced.description: Index entries that could not be placed: the word does not occur in the corpus, or the split is by sense rather than by parse.

root.description: The root whose cells this rule applies to. Must exist in the codex (checked outside this schema).

requires.description: Parse codes a cell must all carry to match. Each must resolve in the language registry (checked outside this schema).

spelling.description: A single spelling the cell must have, for rules narrower than a parse class.
